name: noised-storm
description: NoiseD Storm: procedural rain with Rust/WebAssembly and layered Web Audio thunder.
author: David Portal

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:wasm
scripts.build:js: tsup src/index.ts --dts --format esm,cjs --out-dir dist --clean && tsup src/worklet/rain.worklet.ts --format esm --out-dir dist/worklet
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && cargo test --workspace --locked
